topic: Halstead-Kass-DeRose Catmull-Clark eigen-limit surface stencil vs naive 1-step extraordinary vertex spike rig
topic_zh: Halstead-Kass-DeRose Catmull-Clark 左特征向量极限曲面模板对比朴素单步细分星点尖峰过冲与跳变
scope: Deterministic Mark Halstead, Michael Kass & Tony DeRose (SIGGRAPH 1993 / Pixar OpenSubdiv) left-eigenvector (n, 4, 1) Catmull-Clark limit-surface stencil (P_inf(n) = (n * V0 + 4 * E0 + Q0) / (n + 5) with V0 = 4.00 m, E0 = Q0 = 1.00 m) versus naive 1-step Catmull-Clark subdivision (V1(n) = 4 - 5.25 / n) and 32-level recursive 1-ring matrix refinement across 17 extraordinary vertex valences (n in [3.0, 11.0]).
